name: telemetry__list_datasources
description: List all configured datasources in Grafana. Use this to discover available datasources and their UIDs. Supports filtering by type and/or name (case-insensitive substring match) and pagination.

limit.description: Maximum number of datasources to return (max 100)

name.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the datasource name. For example, 'prod' matches datasources named 'prometheus-prod-eu' and 'loki-prod-us'. Useful on instances with many datasources where filtering by type alone returns too many results.

offset.description: Number of datasources to skip for pagination

type.description: The type of datasources to search for. For example, 'prometheus', 'loki', 'tempo', etc...

name: telemetry__list_prometheus_label_names
description: List label names in a PromQL-compatible datasource (Prometheus, Thanos, Mimir, Cloud Monitoring, etc.). Allows filtering by series selectors and time range.

datasourceUid.description: The UID of the datasource to query

endRfc3339.description: Optionally, the end time of the time range to filter the results by. Supports RFC3339 or relative time (e.g. 'now')

limit.description: Optionally, the maximum number of results to return

name.description: The name of the label to match against

type.description: One of the '=' or '!=' or '=~' or '!~'

matches.description: Optionally, a list of label matchers to filter the results by

projectName.description: GCP project name to query (Cloud Monitoring datasources only). Overrides or substitutes the defaultProject configured on the datasource.

startRfc3339.description: Optionally, the start time of the time range to filter the results by. Supports RFC3339 or relative time (e.g. 'now-1h')

name: telemetry__list_prometheus_label_values
description: Gets the values for a specific label name in a PromQL-compatible datasource (Prometheus, Thanos, Mimir, Cloud Monitoring, etc.). Allows filtering by series selectors and time range.

datasourceUid.description: The UID of the datasource to query

endRfc3339.description: Optionally, the end time of the query. Supports RFC3339 or relative time (e.g. 'now')

labelName.description: The name of the label to query

limit.description: Optionally, the maximum number of results to return

name.description: The name of the label to match against

type.description: One of the '=' or '!=' or '=~' or '!~'

matches.description: Optionally, a list of selectors to filter the results by

projectName.description: GCP project name to query (Cloud Monitoring datasources only). Overrides or substitutes the defaultProject configured on the datasource.

startRfc3339.description: Optionally, the start time of the query. Supports RFC3339 or relative time (e.g. 'now-1h')

name: telemetry__list_prometheus_metric_names
description: Lists metric names in a PromQL-compatible datasource (Prometheus, Thanos, Mimir, Cloud Monitoring, etc.). Filters metric names using the provided regex. Supports pagination (page * limit must not exceed 10000) and an optional time range to restrict results to metrics active within that window. Cloud Monitoring ignores the time range.

datasourceUid.description: The UID of the datasource to query

endRfc3339.description: Optionally, the end time of the time range to filter the results by. Supports RFC3339 or relative time (e.g. 'now')

limit.description: The maximum number of results to return

projectName.description: GCP project name to query (Cloud Monitoring datasources only). Overrides or substitutes the defaultProject configured on the datasource.

regex.description: The regex to match against the metric names

startRfc3339.description: Optionally, the start time of the time range to filter the results by. Supports RFC3339 or relative time (e.g. 'now-1h')

name: telemetry__query_prometheus
description: Query a PromQL-compatible datasource (Prometheus, Thanos, Mimir, Cloud Monitoring, etc.) using a PromQL expression. Returns data without opening a chart. Supports instant and range queries. Time: RFC3339 or relative expressions like 'now', 'now-1h'.

datasourceUid.description: The UID of the datasource to query

endTime.description: The end time. Supported formats are RFC3339 or relative to now (e.g. 'now', 'now-1.5h', 'now-2h45m'). Valid time units are 'ns', 'us' (or 'µs'), 'ms', 's', 'm', 'h', 'd'.

projectName.description: GCP project name to query (Cloud Monitoring datasources only). Overrides or substitutes the defaultProject configured on the datasource.

queryType.description: The type of query to use. Either 'range' or 'instant'

startTime.description: The start time. Required if queryType is 'range', ignored if queryType is 'instant' Supported formats are RFC3339 or relative to now (e.g. 'now', 'now-1.5h', 'now-2h45m'). Valid time units are 'ns', 'us' (or 'µs'), 'ms', 's', 'm', 'h', 'd'.

stepSeconds.description: The time series step size in seconds. Required if queryType is 'range', ignored if queryType is 'instant'
